content: वृष् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (वर्षति, वृष्ट) .²1 To rain (usually with words signifying ‘Indra’, ‘Parjanya’, ‘cloud’, <ab>&c.</ab> as the subject of the verb, or sometimes used impersonally); द्वादश वर्षाणि न ववर्ष दशशताक्षः <ls>Dk.</ls>; काले वर्षन्तु मेघाः; गर्ज वा वर्ष वा शक्र <ls>Mk. 5. 31</ls>; मेघा वर्षन्तु गर्जन्तु मुञ्चन्त्वशनिमेव वा <ls n="Mk.">5. 16</ls>. .²2 To rain or pour down, shower down; वर्षतीवाञ्जनं नभः <ls>Mk. 1. 34</ls>; so शरवृष्टिं, कुसुमवृष्टिं वर्षति <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 To pour forth, shed. .²4 To grant, bestow. .²5 To moisten. .²6 To produce, engender. .²7 To have supreme power. .²8 To strike, hurt. .²9 To drink. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause rain; वर्षति हास्मै वर्षयति <ls>Ch. Up. 2. 3. 2</ls>. --II. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (वर्षयते) .²1 To be powerful or eminent. .²2 To have the power of production.
